about_the_game:
The Enigma Cases: Shadows of Truth – In the Shadow of Reality

This DLC extends the atmosphere of the main game into the invisible battlefield of the modern world.
Shadows of Truth explores a reality where facts can be edited, memories can be weaponized, and information is never neutral.
Fake identities, covert relationships, and the presence of a mysterious organization turn every clue into a potential trap.

Sifting Truth from Noise

Players must question not only what they find, but why it exists.
Which document is authentic, and which is fabricated?
Which statement is testimony, and which is calculated manipulation?
Even publicly available information may be carefully distorted. Reaching the truth is no longer just about collecting evidence. It is about understanding how that evidence has been shaped.

Digital Trails and Silent Manipulation

Shadows of Truth enriches classic interrogation and crime scene work with digital investigation.
You will analyze social media activity, unravel fake message chains, trace cyber footprints, and identify coordinated disinformation patterns.
AI-assisted analysis tools help you uncover hidden links in the data, but final judgment always falls to your own logic and intuition.

Truth, Perception, and Trust

This DLC challenges the idea of “truth” not only through case files, but through motives, narratives, and perception.
A witness can be both victim and manipulator. A confession can double as a smokescreen.
Shadows of Truth constantly asks you one question.
Do you believe what you see, or do you dare to question the shadows behind it?

🔒 Requires the base game The Enigma Cases on Steam to play.

content_descriptors.notes:
Since our game is a detective game, there are different stories in each case.
For example, the cases focus on solving how the deceased people died, whether it was murder or suicide.

When we take the case and go to the scene where the victim died, we reach the adult content there.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX 4350a
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: In a world where truth and lies blend into one, the Shadows of Truth DLC forces you to navigate fake identities, manipulated digital trails, and the silent influence of a hidden organization. Trust becomes your most fragile resource.

*languages with full audio support
